scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Lighthalzen Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to Einbroch, Juno and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮機場。
這裡提供飛往艾音布羅克、朱諾和毀葛的直達航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The boarding fee is
1,200 zeny, but you can
waive the fee if you redeem
a Free Ticket for Airship.
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
登船費為1,200 Zeny，使用飛空艇免費券可免付費用。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have 1,200 zeny to pay
for the boarding fee.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，無法支付1,200 Zeny的登船費。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
please come again.
Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
謝謝，歡迎再次光臨。
祝您今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Lighthalzen Airport.
Please let me guide you to the
main terminal if you are arriving from your flight. Otherwise, please
board the departing Airship to reach your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮機場。
如果您剛下飛空艇，我可以帶您前往主航站樓。
如果您要前往其他目的地，請登上即將出發的飛空艇。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if Lighthalzen is your intended destination. Shall we
proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
進入主航站樓後，若要再次乘坐飛空艇，需要重新支付登船費。
如果您的目的地是裡希塔樂鎮，再從這裡出站。
您要前往主航站樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
好的，感謝您的惠顧，祝您飛行愉快~
